FULL TEXT:
PANJAB UNIVERSITY. CIIANDIGARH
Centre for Skill Development & Entrepreneurship (CSDE)
Walk-In-Interview for Project Staff under the Lead Knowledge Institution (LKI) of State
Support Mission, Chandigarh
Panjab University, Chandigarh, as a Lead Knowledge Institution (LKI) of the State Support Mission,
Chandigarh, for FY 2026-27 , is inyiting eligible candidates to appear for a Walk-In-lnterview for temporary
project posts under the theme Education, Skill Development, Employment & Economic Ability. Elieibility
qualifications, job descriptions, and corresponding emoluments are listed for each project position in the
attached Annexure.
Reporting Date and Time: Tuesday, 08 September 2026 at 10:00 AM
Reporting Venue: Centre for Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (CSDE), First Floor, CALEM
Building, South Campus, Panjab University, Sector 25, Chandigarh
Application Procedure
I . All interested candidates may appear for the Walk-in-Interview at the venue mentioned above at
the specified time, along with the duly filled application form available below.
2. Incomplete application forms and applications that are not in proper fotmat may be summarily
rejected.
3. Candidates should ensure that the information mentioned in the application form is accurate. Once
the application form is submitted, no further requests for changes or information will be considered.
4. The duly filled application form must be submitted at the time of reponing by 10:00 AM on
Tuesday, 08 September 2026.
5. The candidates must asceftain their eligibility before applying for the positions, as ineligible
candidates will not be interviewed.
6. Al1 candidates are requested to appear for the WalkJnJnterview with the application form,
experience certificates, publications and original degree certificates and transcripts.
7. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.
8. Canvassing in any form or bringing influence, political or otherwise, will disqualify the candidate.
9. The posts are purely on a temporary basis and co-terminus with the project's term.
